laws.rule: Piatra Craiului National Park: park ticket 10 lei per person for 7 days (20 lei for two), season ticket 40 lei; under 14 exempt. Visitor centre ticket 5 lei (free with a park ticket). Machines in Zărnești, Plaiul Foii and Valea lui Ivan, or online. (No RBA rate for RON; at the Banca Națională a României rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 3.355 RON: 10 lei ≈ A$2.98; 40 lei ≈ A$11.92)
laws.heading: Piatra Craiului National Park

laws.rule: Bucegi Natural Park: visit fee 10 RON for ages 14 and over, valid 90 days; under 14 free. Pay online by card or in cash to rangers. (No RBA rate for RON; at the Banca Națională a României rate of 30 October 2026, A$1 = about 3.355 RON: 10 RON ≈ A$2.98)
laws.heading: Bucegi Natural Park
